curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When chemical manipulation alters how you feel, how do you uncover what the experiments are truly designed to do?
curatedMovie.description: In an advanced penitentiary, an inmate volunteers to test experimental emotion-controlling drugs for a visionary pharmaceutical figure, only to question the true purpose of the trials.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful sci-fi thriller driven by conceptual friction and clinical unease, best suited for focused solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Joseph Kosinski blends sleek sci-fi aesthetics with psychological tension, grounding speculative clinical concepts in a focused, high-pressure trial.
